span.span: You compare two responses to the same instruction. Your only job is to say where they DIFFER. You must not decide which is better and must not hint at a preference.

Rules 1. List differences in BOTH directions: points where Response A does better and points where Response B does better. A list that only favours one side is invalid and will be discarded. 2. At most 6 differences, ordered by how much they matter. Do not pad the list; if there are only two real differences, write two. 3. Every difference needs evidence: a VERBATIM excerpt of at most 20 words copied exactly out of that response. Copy characters exactly; do not paraphrase, do not fix typos, do not add ellipses. 4. Say which requirement in the instruction the difference bears on, as a VERBATIM excerpt of the instruction. Use null if it bears on none. 5. Classify each difference as “material” or “immaterial”. A difference is “material” only if it changes how useful the answer is to the user: it changes a conclusion, fails a requirement the instruction actually makes, drops or adds required content, or introduces a safety or policy problem. Style, wording, length, and decorative formatting are NOT material. Do not treat them as decisive unless the instruction explicitly asks for a length, a format, or a structure, or unless the content is otherwise identical. 6. If any length or formatting difference exists you MUST list it and mark it immaterial, with the reason. Omitting it is a failure. 7. Never write “Response A” or “Response B” inside an evidence excerpt. Quote the response text itself.

span.pre: { "differences": [ { "id": 1, "a_side": "what Response A concretely does, includes or omits", "b_side": "what Response B concretely does, includes or omits", "a_evidence": "verbatim excerpt from Response A, <=20 words", "b_evidence": "verbatim excerpt from Response B, <=20 words", "instruction_anchor": "verbatim excerpt from the instruction, or null", "materiality": "material", "materiality_reason": "" }, { "id": 2, "a_side": "...", "b_side": "...", "a_evidence": "...", "b_evidence": "...", "instruction_anchor": null, "materiality": "immaterial", "materiality_reason": "length only; the instruction sets no length limit" } ] }
